# watchpoint_usage_budget (Data Source)

Looks up a single usage budget by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_usage_budget" "example" {
  name = "Monthly Spend Cap"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the usage budget to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Usage budget ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is active.
- `mode` (String) Budget evaluation mode: `forecast` or `actual`.
- `notify_email` (String) Email address notified when the budget is breached.
- `product_slug` (String) Product slug the budget is scoped to, if any.
- `threshold_cents` (Number) Spend threshold in cents.
